base_record_snapshot.lesson: A provenance-marker extractor that identifies references by NAMESPACE PREFIX rather than by identifier membership silently counts non-identifiers as identifiers, and any counter built on it stops being a falsifiable instrument. review-close-check.py's build_inscribed_index() extracts refs from provenance HTML comments with `_CPR_REF_RE = r'(cpr_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|CogPR-\d+)'` — matching EVERY `cpr_`-prefixed token in the comment body, not only CogPR ids. The tic-706 guard-9 inscription comment carries the metadata line `era: cpr_era_tic_700_749`; that era LABEL entered the inscribed set as if it were an inscribed CogPR. Measured consequence: the tic-706 review-close mandate predicted `inscribed_index 705->706` (exactly ONE new inscription, the guard-9 ray) and the instrument read 705->707, while the substantive reality was EXACTLY ONE new CogPR inscribed (cpr_mogul_harmony_invoke_675c25f66f97). The apparent double-inscription — which the tic-705 mandate had explicitly declared 'not explicable' — was entirely a measurement artifact. The cure is membership, not pattern: the extractor must resolve each candidate ref against the id namespace it claims to measure (queue.jsonl id set, or an id-shape rule that excludes reserved sibling prefixes such as `cpr_era_`), and a ref that fails resolution must be reported as an unresolved token, never silently admitted. This is the same failure shape as the guard-9 lesson inscribed at this very pass: an instrument whose reading can move without the event it measures makes the prediction unfalsifiable in the miss direction, and every miss then invites explanation-hunting rather than instrument-repair. Scope fence: measured at one locus (federation constitution-ledger, n=1 polluting token; the CGG ledger carries 11 era-tag occurrences but none inside recognized provenance comments, so it is currently unpolluted — the exposure is latent there, not realized).
base_record_snapshot.note: Reproduced exactly: git-diffed the ledger provenance ref-set across commit 35263635 — NEW = {cpr_mogul_harmony_invoke_675c25f66f97, cpr_era_tic_700_749}, GONE = {}. No queue-side anomaly: verdict_counts.promoted moved 686->687, exactly one promotion. Cure is a code change to the extractor plus a decision on whether era tags should be written inside provenance comments at all; both belong to /review, not to this read-only cycle.
